art_direction: bold contemporary launch campaign: one vivid vermilion field, a recognizable oversized subject and deliberate typographic scale; use sharp silhouette, crop and directional shadow to create impact
palette: vermilion #EF442F signature, warm white #FFF5E8 and ink black #171717 neutrals; use one dominant chromatic field per page and keep the same vermilion across the deck
typography: heavy open-counter Chinese sans serif for claims; medium-weight readable direct labels for analytical pages; do not generate a secondary explanatory text tier
materials: dense matte screenprint ink and crisp graphic edges; product pages add real material texture and one directional studio shadow, without glossy interface styling

anchors.prompt: one short vermilion rectangular print tab, reversed to warm white on vermilion backgrounds
a single crisp edge of the main subject, integrated into the composition rather than duplicated as an icon
one decisive vermilion color field with a crisp edge

text_layout: one concise headline as a strong graphic mass; essential product labels or values only, with semantic line breaks and complete unclipped glyphs
contrast: warm-white headline on vermilion or ink-black type on warm white; essential labels use a high-contrast quiet field and remain clear of subject edges
avoid: simultaneous red blue and lime brand palette

poster-claim.label: 色场主张
poster-claim.summary: 用朱红色场、大字和单一主体形成第一眼识别
poster-claim.composition: one high-impact headline mass in the text zone balanced by a boldly cropped subject in the visual zone; use large changes in scale, keeping every glyph intact
poster-claim.imagery: one recognizable content-relevant object or flat photographic cutout against a matte vermilion or warm-white field; hard crop and grounded shadow, without a generic portal metaphor

title_treatment.weight: heavy open-counter sans; semantic line breaks

requirements: one message and one subject dominate
headline may be large but must fit the supplied copy and safe zone
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
headline and subject share the focal hierarchy; avoid leaving the image as a small decorative icon

product-studio.label: 硬光产品
product-studio.summary: 实物纹理与明确投影建立产品存在感
product-studio.composition: one enlarged product or content-relevant object, slightly off-axis in the visual zone, with a crisp directional shadow and a quiet headline margin
product-studio.imagery: photorealistic supplied product, faithful silhouette and surface details, warm-white studio backdrop with a vermilion plane; a service metaphor must stay clearly conceptual

title_treatment.weight: quiet product caption or concise claim

requirements: subject silhouette remains recognizable
copy never crosses the subject or specular highlight
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
avoid: product render that implies unsupported features

campaign-comparison.label: 海报对照
campaign-comparison.summary: 同尺度并置两个选择，用朱红统一视觉
campaign-comparison.composition: two aligned subject fields with matched scale and one common headline; vermilion frames or a shared rule establish one campaign identity
campaign-comparison.imagery: paired object crops or flat diagrams on warm white, matched lighting and label positions; no winning badge unless supplied
requirements: both sides use the same comparison dimension
do not let decoration become a third option
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

campaign-flow.label: 行动图形
campaign-flow.summary: 用粗细明确的路径组织动作
campaign-flow.composition: one bold flat route links the supplied stages across a warm-white field; the stage labels carry more weight than the connecting arrows
campaign-flow.imagery: vermilion connectors, ink-black labels and simple content-relevant silhouettes; clear space at every arrowhead
requirements: stage order must be immediately readable
keep one directional rhythm
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

campaign-data.label: 数字海报
campaign-data.summary: 数字担任主角，比例图形提供比较依据
campaign-data.composition: one supplied key number or a concise proportional comparison takes the visual lead; a smaller headline and clear units occupy aligned positions
campaign-data.imagery: large ink numerals on warm white with vermilion flat bars; if no numeric evidence is supplied, use a text statement instead of inventing a chart
requirements: preserve supplied values, units and comparison baseline
data marks stay flat and proportional; numerical emphasis does not imply unsupported importance
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
show necessary values directly; retain source and verification notes outside the slide unless explicitly required as content

campaign-signal.label: 短句海报
campaign-signal.summary: 一条引文以有力度的排字完成传播
campaign-signal.composition: a single supplied quote arranged as a bold typographic mass on warm white or vermilion, balanced by a short reversed print tab
campaign-signal.imagery: matte solid ink and sharp type; no independent illustrative object unless required by the quote
requirements: the supplied quote remains the only verbal focus
mark stays away from letters
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
